scoring_justification: Magnetic moment compared to paper reference with tolerance; exchange integrals checked for sign and ordering. Recompute from raw DFT/Wannier/cRPA outputs is infeasible without full toolchain.

hidden_assets.purpose: Reference magnetic moment of 1.0 μB per unit cell
hidden_assets.source_provenance: paper Fig 1(c) and the statement 'a local moment of 1 μB per unit cell' in the section 'Origin of local moments'

outputs.description: Magnetic moment per unit cell computed from spin-polarized DFT.
Direct-exchange integrals; must satisfy J_01_D_meV > 0, J_02_D_meV > 0, and J_01_D_meV > J_02_D_meV.

output_contract.notes: Scoring is structural (T3): magnetic moment is compared to a hidden reference with tolerance; exchange integrals are checked for sign and ordering (both positive, J01^D > J02^D). No exact match to paper values is required.
